adaptedNarrationEditScript.safetyPreamble: This is a reflective practice, not medical advice or a tool to diagnose hunger, nutrition, or health. There is no correct response. Pause or stop if this feels distressing and seek qualified support when needed.
script: Welcome. You do not need to solve anything here; simply notice what your body and mind are communicating.
You might name an urge without obeying or fighting it: tired, bored, hungry, uncertain, or something else.
There is no test to pass and no promise that this practice changes a feeling. Keep only what supports you.
Close by choosing one kind next step, including rest or reaching out for professional support.
